SharedFlowBundle.name: SF-Signature-Validator
SharedFlowBundle.Description:
Single entry point for signature validation at the gateway (the API itself provides no validation method). Calling API proxies set the signature.verify.type flow variable (jwt | cavage | xmldsig) and invoke this shared flow via FlowCallout; it routes to the matching sub-step. JWT/JWS uses native VerifyJWS for the JWS check itself (KnownHeaders resolves per-proxy from the shared KVM "signature" via ref, enforcing RFC 7515 §4.1.11's "crit" rule), plus one JavaCallout (JC-JWT-Verify-Extract-Public-Key) to bridge the KeyStore/Alias (also from KVM) into it as a PEM — VerifyJWS's own
does not resolve a dynamic ref at runtime (confirmed against a live Apigee instance; only ServiceCallout/TargetEndpoint's SSLInfo does that). Cavage and XML-DSig verify everything achievable without real RSA/ECDSA math (the signing string / digest) natively in JS, and fault via a clearly marked NI-*-Verify-Signature placeholder for the actual cryptographic check, which needs a JavaCallout — Apigee has no native policy for either, and JS can't reach KeyStore key material to do that math itself.
